title: When the Predators Become the Prey
description:

On May 17, 2023, officers were dispatched for a disturbance caused by a man in the vicinity of La Crosse, WI. Just days earlier, the same individual was reportedly involved in an assault on a woman in an elevator. Upon locating the suspect, he attempted to evade capture by fleeing on foot throughout traffic, but ultimately shook hands with the ground. Further investigation revealed that he was out on several bonds at the time of the incident.
